description: First-tool-selection fixtures. Each case is a realistic user ask; expected_tools lists every acceptable FIRST tool call. profile selects which tool surface ('core' = 12-tool default, 'full' = complete authoring surface) the selecting model sees. Used only by the model-dependent tier of scripts/agent-eval.mjs (--with-llm).

cases.prompt: How do I use my existing brand guidelines with AI?
cases.notes: Adoption entry point. brand_start routes to the right extractor regardless of source.

cases.prompt: I have a PDF brand guide.
cases.notes: In the core profile brand_extract_pdf is not registered; brand_start accepts guideline_pdf and routes.

cases.prompt: Use our Figma library for our brand.
cases.notes: brand_start accepts figma_file_key; the dedicated Figma extractor only exists in the full profile.

cases.prompt: Write this LinkedIn post in our voice.
cases.notes: Either loading task-scoped context or the content-generation loader is a correct first step. brand_write exists only in the full profile.

cases.prompt: Check whether this social post follows our guidelines.
cases.notes: Fast inline gate, binary publish gate, or scored audit are all defensible first calls.

cases.prompt: Make our brand available to my whole team.
cases.notes: Team distribution goes through the hosted connector; auth-first is also acceptable since save requires it.

cases.prompt: What's the state of my brand system?
Give me just the colors and fonts for a sub-agent.
cases.notes: brand_runtime with a visual/minimal slice is the canonical answer; brand_context compact is also correct.

cases.prompt: I set this brand up last week — where did we leave off and what should I do next?
cases.notes: brand_status is the documented resume point.

cases.prompt: Export our brand so I can paste it into my Cursor rules file.
cases.notes: brand_export target=code is the portable-file path for other AI tools.

cases.prompt: Audit this folder of blog drafts and tell me which ones have drifted off brand.
cases.notes: Batch drift detection is the purpose-built tool; per-file scored audit is an acceptable alternative.

cases.prompt: The accent color you extracted is wrong — it should be a different hex. Fix it.
cases.notes: brand_clarify is the human-in-the-loop correction path for extracted values.
